# ATI Business Essentials

> ATI Business Essentials is an Arvada, Colorado company that builds Leads Plus, a lead and bid tracking platform for service businesses, and manages Google Ads, marketing, safety compliance, and website support for contractors nationwide.

Key facts:
- Legal name: ATI Business Essentials, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of ATI Products, LLC (sister company: ATI Construction Products, https://ati-constructionproducts.com/).
- Location: Arvada, CO, USA. Serves service businesses nationwide.
- Phone: (800) 360-6115. Email: info@ati-businessessentials.com.
- Flagship product: Leads Plus, a lead and bid tracking platform that syncs qualified leads and quote values to Google Ads. From $299/month plus $699 onboarding.
- Also offers: Marketing Hub software, managed Google Ads, Google Ads support and training, safety portal (ISNetworld, Avetta, Veriforce) compliance management, SiteDocs safety software, OSHAWise and MSHAWise, and Fix My Site website support.

## Home: Leads Plus for Service Businesses
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/

Track every lead. Track every bid. Train Google to send better jobs.

**What is Leads Plus?** Leads Plus is a lead and bid tracking platform from ATI Business Essentials built for contractors and service businesses that win work through bids and estimates. It captures website form leads and phone calls automatically, tracks bid amounts and status, and sends qualified-lead data back to Google Ads so your ads find more customers like your best ones.
- Starts at $299/month plus $699 onboarding
- Unlimited users, works in any web browser
- Pairs with managed Google Ads for a complete lead engine

### Sound Familiar?
Most service businesses deal with the same problems every day.
- **CRMs are too complicated and too costly for your team.**
- **Not enough quality leads.**
- **No clear visibility into bid status and value.**
- **Google sends junk leads you can’t use.**
- **No feedback loop to improve your ads.**
- **Marketing feels completely disconnected.**

### The Solution: ATI’s Leads Plus for Service Businesses
Stop fighting your CRM and start managing your leads. Leads Plus strips away the complexity and gives you a streamlined system that tracks every inquiry and phone call automatically. You get accurate lifecycle reporting and manageable leads without the technical headaches. It is lead management, simplified.
- Simple lead and call capture from your website
- Clean pipeline with no CRM clutter
- Track bids, job types, and status
- Tag qualified opportunities instantly
- A dashboard built for clarity

### Leads Plus + Paid Ads + Marketing Hub
Built to work together. Tools and support that help service businesses attract leads, manage marketing, and turn opportunities into growth.

- 150+: Clients helped nationwide
- 4.9 Stars: Rated by our clients
- 25+: Years of combined client success experience

### How Leads Plus Works
Five steps turn every inquiry into data that makes your advertising smarter.
1. **Lead Comes In**: Every form fill and phone call from your website or landing page is captured automatically.
2. **Track the Bid**: Log bid amounts, job types, and status in seconds.
3. **Mark Qualified Jobs**: Tag the leads that are real opportunities.
4. **Google Learns**: Qualified data syncs with your Google Ads account.
5. **Better Leads Come In**: Google targets more people like your best customers.

### It Doesn’t Just Track Your Bids.
It teaches Google who your best customers are.
When you mark a lead as qualified, that data syncs with your advertising. Google uses it to improve targeting, so the leads you get keep getting better over time. Leads Plus also records the dollar value of each quote in Google Ads, which lets you compare revenue against ad spend and see your true return on investment.

### Why Service Businesses Choose Leads Plus
- **Lower Cost Per Lead**: Stop paying for junk leads. Train Google to find real opportunities.
- **Clear Revenue Visibility**: See exactly what is in your pipeline and what is closing.
- **Better Close Rates**: Focus on qualified jobs, not tire-kickers.
- **Zero Software Overwhelm**: No CRM bloat. Just leads, bids, and results.
- **Built for Service Businesses**: Designed for companies that run on bids and estimates.
- **Connect Marketing Hub**: Connect social media, websites, and paid ads to Leads Plus for better, more qualified marketing.

### Leads Plus FAQ

**Q: Is Leads Plus a CRM?**
A: No. Leads Plus is a focused lead and bid tracking system. It skips the contact-management bloat of a full CRM and only tracks what service businesses need: incoming leads, calls, bid amounts, job types, and win or loss status.

**Q: How does Leads Plus improve Google Ads results?**
A: When you mark a lead as qualified, Leads Plus sends that conversion back to Google Ads along with the dollar value of the quote. Google then optimizes toward people who look like your qualified leads instead of anyone who fills out a form, which lowers cost per qualified lead over time.

**Q: How much does Leads Plus cost?**
A: Leads Plus with a website connection is $299 per month. Leads Plus with website and call tracking is $349 per month. Both include a one-time $699 onboarding fee, unlimited users, and up to 3 edits per month. Bundling with managed Google Ads saves over 10%.

**Q: Who is Leads Plus built for?**
A: Contractors and service businesses that quote or bid before winning a job, including roofers, scaffolding companies, general contractors, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, excavation, landscaping, and dozens of other trades across the United States.

**Q: Do I need to change my website to use Leads Plus?**
A: No. ATI connects your existing website forms during onboarding. If you do not want to connect your site, ATI can build a standalone landing page that feeds Leads Plus for $999 setup and $65 per month.

## Leads Plus
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/leads-plus

A simple, powerful system built for service businesses that operate on bids and estimates. Paired with Google Ads, it becomes a complete lead engine.

**What does Leads Plus do?** Leads Plus captures every website form and phone call, organizes them into a clean pipeline, and lets you track each bid from New to Bidding to Won or Lost. When you tag a lead as qualified, the data and the quote value sync to Google Ads, so your advertising learns which customers are worth paying for.

### What Is Leads Plus?
Leads Plus is a simple bid tracking platform with no extra frills or bloated features. It captures your website or landing page forms and phone calls and organizes them into a clean pipeline, so you can easily see what is coming in, what you are bidding on, and what is closing.
- Capture lead forms and calls automatically from websites and landing pages
- Track bid amounts and job types
- Track status: New, Bidding, Won, Lost
- Tag qualified opportunities
- Simple dashboard with zero CRM clutter
- Access directly in any web browser

### Leads Plus + Managed Google Ads
Combine your Google Ads with your Leads Plus platform: strategy, optimization, and ongoing performance management, built to work together.
- **Campaign Strategy**: Custom campaigns built for your service area.
- **Ongoing Optimization**: Continuous improvement based on real data.
- **Performance Tracking**: Clear reporting tied to real opportunities.
- **Smart Sync**: Qualified data connects to your advertising automatically.

### It Doesn’t Just Track Your Bids. It Teaches Google Who Your Best Customers Are.
When you mark a lead as qualified, that data syncs with your advertising.
- Improves data accuracy and helps Google find more customers like your best ones.
- Adds the dollar value of your leads and quotes to your Google Ads account, so you can track revenue against ad spend for a true return on investment.
- Built specifically for the service contracting industry, with results-driven functionality most agencies do not offer.

### This Is Not a CRM
It is a focused lead and bid tracking system, paired with expert Google Ads management, built specifically for service businesses. No bloat. No complexity. Just results.

### Leads Plus Questions, Answered

**Q: What is the difference between Leads Plus and a CRM?**
A: A CRM manages every contact, deal stage, email sequence, and task across a company. Leads Plus only does what bid-based service businesses need: capture leads and calls, track bid amounts and status, and tag qualified jobs. That focus makes it faster to adopt and lets it feed clean conversion data to Google Ads.

**Q: What are the Leads Plus bid statuses?**
A: Every lead moves through four statuses: New, Bidding, Won, and Lost. You can also tag any lead as a qualified opportunity, which is the signal Leads Plus sends to Google Ads.

**Q: Can Leads Plus track phone calls?**
A: Yes. The Leads Plus + Website + Call Connection plan ($349 per month) adds call tracking, so phone leads appear in your pipeline alongside form submissions.

**Q: How many users can access Leads Plus?**
A: Every plan includes unlimited users. Leads Plus runs in a web browser, so there is nothing to install.

**Q: What does onboarding include?**
A: Onboarding is a one-time $699 fee that covers connecting your website forms (and calls, if selected) plus unlimited edits and modifications discussed during onboarding. After launch, each plan includes up to 3 edits per month.

**Q: Do I have to use ATI for Google Ads to use Leads Plus?**
A: No. Leads Plus works on its own. Bundling it with ATI’s managed Google Ads saves over 10% and gives you a team that uses your qualified-lead data to optimize campaigns.

Marketing Hub connects your ads, social, and website data, with AI-powered insights from your pipeline.

### Marketing FAQ

**Q: How much does Google Ads management cost at ATI?**
A: Paid Ads Management has a $999 setup fee plus a monthly fee based on ad spend: $450/month for spend under $2,500 (dropping to $400 after 6 months), $750/month for $2,500 to $5,000 (dropping to $600), and $1,500/month above $5,000 (dropping to $1,200). Each plan includes one meeting per month.

**Q: What is the difference between Paid Ad Management and Paid Ad Support?**
A: Paid Ad Management is done for you: ATI builds, runs, and optimizes your campaigns. Paid Ad Support is advisory: you keep running your own ads while ATI reviews campaigns, audits tracking, recommends budget and keyword changes, and trains your team.

**Q: Which ad platforms do you work with?**
A: Google Ads is the primary platform. Paid Ad Support also covers Microsoft Ads and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads.

**Q: What is Marketing Hub?**
A: Marketing Hub is ATI’s marketing software. It connects your website, social media, paid ads, and Leads Plus data in one dashboard, logs every marketing change, shows its impact on leads and revenue, and uses AI to recommend where to focus. It costs $299/month plus $999 onboarding.

**Q: Are your specialists Google certified?**
A: Yes. The team holds Google Ads Search, Google Ads Display, and Google Analytics conversion optimization certifications through Google Skillshop.

## Safety Portal Compliance
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/safety-portal-maintenance

From submissions to scorecards, we handle every detail of your safety prequalification so you remain qualified, competitive, and ready for the next job.

**What is safety portal maintenance?** Safety portal maintenance is a managed service where ATI Business Essentials completes and maintains your contractor safety prequalification in portals such as ISNetworld®, Avetta®, Veriforce®, Highwire, ComplyWorks, and Browz. ATI submits documents correctly the first time, answers questionnaires strategically, tracks recurring reporting deadlines, and responds to non-compliance notices to protect your grade. It is billed at $100 per hour.

### Stay Project-Ready in Every Contractor Portal
ATI Business Essentials simplifies your compliance process. With over 20 years of industry experience, we manage and maintain your safety prequalification across ISNetworld®, Avetta®, Veriforce®, Highwire, ComplyWorks, Browz, and client-specific portals, so you are always project-ready.

### What We Take Off Your Plate
- **Time Savings**: Constant upload revisions and portal rejections can delay projects for weeks. We make sure everything is submitted correctly the first time, eliminating back-and-forth and keeping you project-ready.
- **Clarity & Accuracy**: Technical questionnaires are easy to misinterpret, which often triggers unnecessary compliance requirements. We complete them strategically and accurately to prevent extra work and confusion.
- **Ongoing Maintenance**: Managing monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting alongside daily operations leads to missed deadlines and lapses. We proactively track, update, and maintain every requirement so nothing slips through the cracks.
- **Strong Safety Grades**: Non-compliance notices and score updates get buried, and scores drop quickly. We monitor and address issues immediately to protect your grade, your reputation, and your ability to win work.

### Safety Portal Maintenance Pricing
- **Safety Portal Maintenance (Hourly)**: $100 per hour. Hands-on portal management billed hourly. Ask about monthly options.

### Safety Portal FAQ

**Q: Which safety prequalification portals do you manage?**
A: ISNetworld®, Avetta®, Veriforce®, Highwire, ComplyWorks, Browz, and client-specific portals.

**Q: How much does safety portal maintenance cost?**
A: Safety portal maintenance is billed at $100 per hour. Contact ATI for a scope estimate based on how many portals and hiring clients you have.

**Q: Can you help raise a low ISNetworld or Avetta grade?**
A: Yes. ATI monitors non-compliance notices and score changes, fixes the underlying document or questionnaire issues, and resubmits so your grade recovers and you stay approved to bid.

**Q: How much experience does ATI have with safety compliance?**
A: The team has over 20 years of industry experience managing contractor safety programs and prequalification.

## Safety Compliance Software
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/safety-compliance-software

SiteDocs digitizes your entire safety program, from toolbox talks to inspections, so nothing gets missed. Reduce risk, increase visibility, and keep your crews safer while staying focused on the job.

**What is SiteDocs?** SiteDocs is a digital safety management platform that replaces paper forms for contractors. It handles FLRAs, JSAs, toolbox talks, inspections, and OSHA 300 logs, sends automatic certification alerts, and works offline on job sites. Booking a SiteDocs demo through ATI Business Essentials includes an automatic 10% discount.

### Paper-Free Safety Compliance, From Small Crews to Multinationals
SiteDocs replaces cumbersome paper systems with a streamlined digital platform for contractors across the United States. Smaller firms cut the administrative burden of manual paperwork, while large organizations use its SOC 2 certified data security and real-time dashboards to spot injury trends and improve site performance.

By digitizing documents like FLRAs, JSAs, and OSHA 300 logs, SiteDocs customers have reported saving over $100,000 in administrative costs in a single year and a 22.5% decrease in common workplace injuries, according to SiteDocs. Crews adapt quickly, data processing takes days instead of weeks, and safety culture becomes proactive on every job site.

Book a SiteDocs demo and receive an automatic 10% discount.

### Benefits of Using SiteDocs
- **Streamline Compliance Monitoring**: Monitor worker and contractor adherence with instant tracking.
- **Automatic Certification Alerts**: Automated notifications keep staff, contractors, and managers current on safety protocols.
- **Automate Form Repetition**: Forms, safety meetings, and documentation repeat automatically after initial setup.
- **Personal Task Management**: Workers and contractors get personalized form assignments that eliminate site confusion.
- **Simple Interface, Quick Adoption**: An intuitive platform that crews actually use, which improves workplace safety.
- **Work Without Connection**: Keep working offline. SiteDocs syncs automatically once connectivity returns.

### Safety Compliance Software Case Studies
- **Clyde Chose SiteDocs Over 10 Other Digital Safety Systems**: Clyde Companies is the parent of 8 subsidiaries employing more than 4,500 people. Its corporate safety director credits both the system and the SiteDocs team’s responsiveness to their specific needs.
- **Over 4 Years With No Lost-Time Injuries**: Tri-Mach, a food-equipment manufacturer with plants in the United States and Canada, wrote about how digital safety with SiteDocs transformed its safety program.
- **Phoenix Cut Days With Work Restrictions by 71%**: With job sites across the continental United States, Phoenix Fabricators and Erectors used SiteDocs to streamline communication and accountability between crews and the corporate office.
- **Lafarge Canada Went Digital Across 180 Locations**: Lafarge Canada moved its safety workflows from paper to SiteDocs at 180 locations, cutting paper waste as part of its goal to become a net zero concrete company.
- **How Signal Peak Silica Stays Safety Ready**: In the Texas energy industry, verifying training quickly is critical. Signal Peak Silica uses SiteDocs for fast access to training documentation.
- **Cake Builds a Faster, Easier Safety Culture in New Zealand**: Cake’s project team highlights SiteDocs’ ease of use and offline mode for remote work as key to improving its safety culture.
- **Mainland Machinery Maintains COR™ With Customized Safety Systems**: A family-owned Western Canada fabricator with more than 50 years and over 1 million shop hours tailors SiteDocs to the safety needs of oil and gas, cement, mining, agriculture, and medical clients.

### SiteDocs FAQ

**Q: Does SiteDocs work without internet on a job site?**
A: Yes. Crews can keep filling out forms offline, and SiteDocs syncs automatically when the device reconnects.

**Q: What safety documents can SiteDocs digitize?**
A: Field level risk assessments (FLRAs), job safety analyses (JSAs), toolbox talks and safety meetings, inspections, certifications, and OSHA 300 logs, among others.

**Q: How do I get the 10% SiteDocs discount?**
A: Book your SiteDocs demo through ATI Business Essentials. The 10% discount is applied automatically.

**Q: Is SiteDocs secure enough for large companies?**
A: SiteDocs is SOC 2 certified and is used by large multi-site organizations such as Clyde Companies and Lafarge Canada.

## OSHA & MSHA Companion
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/osha-msha

Access OSHA and MSHA regulations, interpretations, and case law in one AI-powered platform, so you can find answers faster, reduce risk, and stay compliant with confidence.

**What are OSHAWise and MSHAWise?** OSHAWise and MSHAWise are AI-powered compliance research platforms. OSHAWise covers OSHA standards and MSHAWise covers mine safety (MSHA) rules. Each combines regulations, official interpretations, and case law in one searchable tool with AI copilots that answer compliance questions in seconds. Each subscription is $228 through ATI Business Essentials.

### OSHAWise & MSHAWise Compliance Resources
OSHAWise and MSHAWise combine decades of regulatory guidance, interpretations, and case law into one intelligent, searchable platform. With advanced AI copilots, you can quickly find answers, understand enforcement trends, and make confident compliance decisions in seconds.

### Subscriptions
- **OSHAWise Subscription**: $228. OSHA regulations, interpretations, and case law with an AI copilot.
- **MSHAWise Subscription**: $228. MSHA regulations, interpretations, and case law with an AI copilot.

### OSHAWise & MSHAWise FAQ

**Q: What is the difference between OSHAWise and MSHAWise?**
A: OSHAWise covers Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards. MSHAWise covers Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) rules for mining operations. Both include regulations, interpretations, and case law.

**Q: How much do OSHAWise and MSHAWise cost?**
A: Each subscription is $228 when purchased through ATI Business Essentials.

**Q: Who should use OSHAWise or MSHAWise?**
A: Safety directors, compliance managers, contractors, and mine operators who need fast, reliable answers about what a regulation requires and how it has been enforced.

## Pricing
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/pricing

Leads Plus, Marketing Hub, and managed ads, built to help you get more leads and close more jobs. Bundle Leads Plus with Ad Management to save over 10%.

**How much does Leads Plus cost?** Leads Plus costs $299 per month with a website connection, or $349 per month with website and call tracking, plus a one-time $699 onboarding fee. Marketing Hub is $299 per month plus $999 onboarding. Google Ads management is a $999 setup plus $450 to $1,500 per month depending on ad spend, and the monthly fee drops after 6 months.

### Leads Plus Subscription Plans
- **Leads Plus + Website Connection**: Access to Leads Plus (online version), unlimited users, website form connection.
  - Onboarding: $699 (Includes unlimited edits and modifications discussed at onboarding.)
  - Subscription: $299/month (Online Leads Plus platform with unlimited users and a connection to your website. Up to 3 edits per month after implementation.)
  - Over 10% discount when bundled with Ad Management.
- **Leads Plus + Website + Call Connection**: Everything in the website plan plus call connection to track phone leads.
  - Onboarding: $699 (Includes unlimited edits and modifications discussed at onboarding.)
  - Subscription: $349/month (Online Leads Plus platform with unlimited users and connections to your website and calls. Up to 3 edits per month after implementation.)
  - Over 10% discount when bundled with Ad Management.

### Marketing Plans
- **Marketing Hub**: Access to Marketing Hub (online version), unlimited users, with website, social media, paid ads, and Leads Plus connections.
  - Onboarding: $999 (Connecting all data and analytics from your website, social media, paid ads, and Leads Plus.)
  - Subscription: $299/month (Online Marketing Hub platform with unlimited users.)
- **Paid Ads Management**: Account and ad setup, then monthly management with one meeting per month. Pricing drops at 6 months.
  - Tier A (ad spend under $2,500): $999 setup + $450/month (Drops to $400/month after 6 months.)
  - Tier B ($2,500 to $5,000): $999 setup + $750/month (Drops to $600/month after 6 months.)
  - Tier C ($5,000+): $999 setup + $1,500/month (Drops to $1,200/month after 6 months.)
  - Over 10% discount when bundled with Leads Plus.

### Add-Ons
- **Landing Page Development**: An independent landing page that sends leads to Leads Plus. An alternative to connecting your website.
  - Setup: $999
  - Hosting: $65/month
- **Website Development & Hosting**: Simple, reliable website development and hosting. Built to perform, easy to manage, and designed to grow with your business.
  - Setup: $2,999
  - Hosting: $65/month

### Pricing FAQ

**Q: Are there long-term contracts?**
A: No. ATI Business Essentials does not require long-term contracts.

**Q: How do I get the bundle discount?**
A: Combine a Leads Plus plan with Paid Ads Management. Both are discounted by over 10% when bundled.

**Q: What counts as an edit or modification?**
A: Changes to your Leads Plus setup after launch, such as adding a form, a field, a job type, or a call source. Each plan includes up to 3 per month, and onboarding includes unlimited edits discussed during setup.

**Q: Why does Ads Management pricing depend on ad spend?**
A: Larger budgets mean more campaigns, keywords, and testing to manage. The tiers match the management workload, and every tier drops in price after 6 months once campaigns are optimized.

## About ATI Business Essentials
URL: https://ati-businessessentials.com/about

We help service businesses take control of their leads, track their bids, and grow with smarter Google Ads, all with tools that are actually simple to use.

**Who is ATI Business Essentials?** ATI Business Essentials, LLC is a marketing and software company in Arvada, Colorado, and a wholly owned subsidiary of ATI Products, LLC. It builds Leads Plus and Marketing Hub, manages Google Ads, and provides safety compliance and website services for service businesses across the United States. It was founded by Darren Franz and Sabra Starr.

### What We Stand For
- **Simplicity**: We build tools that service businesses can actually use, without a training manual.
- **Service Industry Focus**: We only work with businesses that run on bids and estimates.
- **Results First**: Every feature exists to help you close more jobs and waste less money.
- **Transparency**: Clear reporting, honest strategy, and no long-term contracts.

### Why We Built Leads Plus
We watched service business owners struggle with bloated CRMs, disconnected marketing, and Google Ads that sent junk leads. So we built a simpler way: a focused lead and bid tracking system that makes Google smarter over time.

### Meet the Founding Partners
- **Darren Franz** (Founding Partner): Darren built the company with a clear vision: create a simple, results-driven system that helps service businesses grow. With years of hands-on experience alongside contractors and business owners, he understands what it takes to generate consistent, qualified work. His focus is strategy, long-term relationships, and systems that scale.
- **Sabra Starr** (Founding Partner): Sabra leads development and day-to-day execution of the platform, including the creation of Marketing Hub and the systems that support client growth. She works directly with business owners to capture leads, manage marketing, and turn opportunities into consistent work. Her focus is simple, organized tools that make marketing easier and more effective.

### Why Choose Us?
- **Built for Service Businesses**: We understand how contractors and home service companies grow: through steady, qualified jobs, not vanity metrics.
- **Simplicity Over Complexity**: No bloated marketing packages. Just a focused lead system designed to generate real opportunities.
- **Data-Driven Improvement**: Our system sends real lead data back into Google to continuously optimize performance.
- **Clear Visibility**: With the optional Marketing Hub, you see all your marketing activity in one simple, organized place.
- **Results That Matter**: We measure success by qualified leads and booked work, not impressions or clicks.
- **Part of ATI Products, LLC**: A sister company to ATI Construction Products, maker of AdjustaStairs™, so we know the jobsite as well as the marketing.
